property_summary: For any token id that has never been minted (ownerOf(id) is the zero address), a call to c.transferFrom from any caller must revert, because the WRONG_FROM check rejects from != _ownerOf[id]; deleting that check lets a caller pass from == msg.sender and 'mint' an unminted token, making ownerOf(id) return a nonzero address.
change_summary: Delete the `WRONG_FROM` check so a caller can pass an incorrect `from` and still move the token, changing `_ownerOf`.
